title: El sistema bicameral y el Congreso de los Diputados
goal: Comprender la composición bicameral de las Cortes Generales y la elección de los 350 diputados del Congreso.

items: Identify the Cortes Generales as Spain's bicameral parliament formed by the Congress of Deputies and the Senate.
State that the Congress of Deputies consists of 350 deputies elected for a 4-year term.
Recognize the province as the electoral constituency for general elections.
Use 'componerse de' and 'estar formado por' to describe parliamentary composition.
I can identify the Cortes Generales as Spain's bicameral parliament formed by the Congress of Deputies and the Senate.
I can state that the Congress of Deputies consists of 350 deputies elected for a 4-year term.
I can recognize the province as the electoral constituency for general elections.
I can use 'componerse de' and 'estar formado por' to describe parliamentary composition.
